domain: Arbitrary X, arity n, quantitative bundle h_X, and paired liftings constructed from the paper's combinator, aggregator, and barycenter operators.
assumptions: z o combinator_quant = combinator_truth o (z x z)
z o aggregator_quant = aggregator_truth o z^A
z o barycenter_quant = barycenter_truth o P(z)
quantified_conclusion: For every h_X, z o lambda_X^quant(h_X) = lambda_X^truth(z o h_X).
acceptance: A complete structural-induction certificate covers each lifting constructor; an independent normalizer agrees; removing any algebra law makes the proof fail.
